media.altZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾谈与"巅峰之巅"的马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的现实 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar on reality of racing alongside "prime of the prime" Max Verstappen
detailZh: 伊萨克·哈德贾谈与"巅峰之巅"的马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战的现实
伊萨克·哈德贾已经描述自己与马克斯·维斯塔潘并肩作战是非常幸运的
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、伊萨克·哈德贾、红牛车队
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，了解一级方程式新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和比赛分析，来自米尔顿凯恩斯。
红牛一级方程式车手伊萨克·哈德贾认为，能与四届冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘搭档是非常幸运的，他表示自己正处于职业生涯的巅峰时刻面对这位荷兰人。
最近与米尔顿凯恩斯车队续约至2027赛季的哈德贾，被赋予了与维斯塔潘搭档的艰巨任务。
在一级方程式的《超越网格》播客中，这位22岁的年轻人详细描述了与维斯塔潘共享维修区空间的现实。
“我知道我可能正处于一级方程式所能达到的最高水平的巅峰时刻，而他就在我旁边的维修区里，”哈德贾解释道。“所以在我这个年纪，在我的职业生涯早期就能有这样的经历，我非常幸运。因此，仅为此，我就感到非常感激，这真是太棒了。”
他补充说：“但我喜欢挑战。我喜欢进入每一节练习时都知道他将设定一个我需要匹配并超越的基准。这真的很令人兴奋。它改变了我整个职业生涯的一切。”
尽管哈德杰认为他的单圈速度可以与之相媲美，但他承认维斯塔潘在比赛日的执行是无与伦比的。
“我会说这正是我预期的维斯塔潘在赛道上的表现。我对他的实力有一个概念，并且这体现得非常好，”他继续说道。
“我在心中想要在赛道上实现的目标，他都能做到。但你的目标和你实际完成的事情之间总是存在差距。”
有时候总会有那么一点差距，但他一直很稳定。他并没有真正意义上的低谷时刻。他从不犯错。他总是出现在正确的时机，正确的地点。他创造了自己的运气。
比如说在赛道上，你有15个弯道，可能你擅长其中一两个，或者两三个、四五个弯道，你做得非常好。但他能在那里匹配你，然后在其他弯道，他保持同样的水平。
然后在整个圈中，他创造了圈速差距。我不会说我看数据时，就像'我无法复制这个'。这是他做到的频率。这最终造成了巨大的差异。他没有高峰。它是平的。它在那里，但它是平的。这就是他成为如此难以对付的车手的原因。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar on reality of racing alongside "prime of the prime" Max Verstappen
Isack Hadjar has described himself as "very, very lucky" to race alongside Max Verstappen
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Isack Hadjar, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Red Bull Formula 1 driver Isack Hadjar believes he is "very, very lucky" to be partnered with four-time champion Max Verstappen, stating he is facing the Dutchman at the "prime of the prime" of his career.
Hadjar, who recently secured a contract extension to remain at the Milton Keynes outfit through the 2027 season, has been tasked with the notoriously difficult role of driving alongside Verstappen.
Speaking on Formula 1's Beyond The Grid podcast, the 22-year-old detailed the reality of sharing garage space with Verstappen.

"I know I'm probably facing the prime of the prime of the level you can achieve in Formula 1, and he's just next to me in the garage," Hadjar explained. "So to experience this at my age, this early in my career, I'm one very, very lucky guy. So just for that, I'm thankful, and it's great."

He added: "But I love the challenge. I love going into every session knowing that he's going to set a benchmark that I need to match and I need to overcome. It's just exciting. It changes everything I've had my whole career."
While Hadjar feels his single-lap pace compares favourably, he admitted that Verstappen's race-day execution remains unparalleled.
"I would say it's exactly what I expected Max Verstappen to be on the track. I had an idea of how good he was, and it translates really well," he continued.
"What I have in my mind that I want to achieve on track, he does it. But there's always a difference between what you're aiming to do and what you actually deliver.

"There's always a little gap sometimes, but he's constant. He doesn't really have low moments. He makes no mistakes. He's always at the right time, the right place as well. He creates his own luck a bit.

"Let's say on a track, you have like 15 corners and maybe there's one corner you master, or two, three, four, five corners, you do really, really well. But he matches you there and then on the others, he keeps that same level.

"And then over the lap, he makes the lap time difference. I wouldn't say I look at the data and I'm like, 'I can't reproduce this'. It's how often he does it. That makes the big difference at the end. He has no peak. It's flat. It's up there, but it's flat. It's what makes him such a tough driver."

items.summaryZh: 法拉利宣布将青训车手迪诺·贝加诺维奇提升为2027赛季的F1预备车手。贝加诺维奇曾是法拉利车手学院的一员，曾赢得意大利和瑞典卡丁车锦标赛冠军，并在WSK Euro Series中获得亚军。

items.originalTitle: Ferrari promotes F2 racer to F1 reserve driver role
detailZh: 法拉利提升F2车手至F1预备车手角色
迪诺·贝加诺维奇将离开F2，专注于与斯库德里亚的F1职责
法拉利将青训车队车手迪诺·贝加诺维奇提升为2027赛季的F1预备车手。
贝加诺维奇在过去七年一直是法拉利车手学院的一员，在此期间他赢得了意大利和瑞典卡丁车锦标赛冠军，并在WSK Euro Series中获得亚军。
在他的年轻车手项目中，贝加诺维奇以单座赛车新手的身份在意大利F4中排名第三，在第二次尝试中赢得了欧洲区域锦标赛冠军，并在他的F3赛季中排名第六。目前，这位DAMS车手在2026年F2积分榜上位列第五——再次作为二年级生——在马德里赛道和巴库连续获胜。
尽管在所有他全职参加的比赛中都赢得了比赛，贝加诺维奇还是被另一位法拉利培养的年轻车手，年轻的拉斐尔·卡马拉超越了。这位巴西人在F2锦标赛中作为新秀领跑，并与哈斯车队签订了2027年的F1合同，在那里他预计将与FDA校友奥利弗·贝尔曼搭档。
因此，贝加诺维奇的青训生涯即将结束，他将在没有F1驾驶机会的情况下加入安东尼奥·吉奥维纳齐，进入法拉利的预备名单。这位22岁的瑞典-波斯尼亚人，在2025年和2026年参加了四次FP1练习，将承担额外的开发任务。
尽管卡马拉和贝加诺维奇离开了F2，但明年F1的卫星系列赛仍将有一位法拉利培养的车手。图库卡·塔帕嫩在本赛季结束前排名第三，得益于在最后两轮中取得的三个领奖台位置——在此之前，他在2026年还没有取得过任何前三名的成绩。
detailEn: Ferrari promotes F2 racer to F1 reserve driver role
Dino Beganovic will leave Formula 2 to focus on his F1 duties with the Scuderia
Ferrari is promoting its junior driver Dino Beganovic to a Formula 1 reserve driver role for the 2027 season.
Beganovic has been a member of the Ferrari Driver Academy for the past seven years, after he won the Italian and Swedish karting championships and took the runner-up spot in the WSK Euro Series.

During his time in the young-driver programme, Beganovic finished third as a single-seater rookie in Italian F4, claimed the Formula Regional European Championship title at his second attempt and finished sixth in both his F3 seasons. The DAMS driver currently lies fifth in the 2026 F2 standings – again as a sophomore – with back-to-back victories in Madring and Baku.

Despite winning races in all competitions he has raced in full-time, Beganovic has been surpassed by another Ferrari protege, the younger Rafael Camara. The Brazilian currently leads the F2 championship as a rookie and signed a 2027 F1 deal with Haas, where he is expected to partner fellow FDA graduate Oliver Bearman.

As a consequence, Beganovic’s junior career is coming to an end without an F1 drive, and he will join Antonio Giovinazzi in Ferrari’s reserve roster. The 22-year-old Swedish-Bosnian, who has taken part in four FP1 sessions with the Scuderia across 2025 and 2026, will have additional development duties.

Despite Camara and Beganovic moving on from F2, there will be a Ferrari protege in F1’s feeder series next year. Tuukka Taponen will graduate from F3 after finishing third this season, courtesy of a remarkable three podiums in the final two rounds – he hadn’t taken a single top-three finish prior to this in 2026.
keyPointsZh: 贝加诺维奇将担任2027赛季F1预备车手
keyPointsEn: Dino Beganovic will be a Formula 1 reserve driver for the 2027 season

items.originalTitle: F2 rebuffs suggestion its title race might be over because of the Iran war
items.summaryEn: Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel has stated that the 2026 season-concluding Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds "will not be cancelled", despite the threat of the Iran war.
detailZh: F2驳斥因伊朗战争导致赛季提前结束的说法
F2首席执行官米歇尔坚称收官轮将按计划进行，不会追溯性地加冕冠军
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，尽管伊朗战争带来威胁，2026赛季收官战卡塔尔站和阿布扎比站“不会取消”。
美国与以色列于2月下旬发动的冲突导致中东局势不稳。在整体局势中影响较小的后果之一是对赛历的冲击：F2的巴林站和沙特站被迈阿密站和蒙特利尔站替代，因为该系列赛与F1同场举行。
据了解，F1和赛事组织者都希望按计划举办这些赛事，并且出于明显的财务原因，也不愿单方面取消它们。尽管如此，世界锦标赛一直在准备应急计划，如果这两场大奖赛无法举行，伊莫拉准备在12月的第一个周末顶替。
与此同时，二级方程式在9月底为其巴库赛程增加了一场比赛，这正是一级方程式在马德里赛季收官战中所做的，以弥补巴林站的损失——因此巴库的决定被视为为潜在取消做准备的一种方式。
然而，米歇尔坚称锦标赛的计划没有改变：“目前——我认为这完全清楚——卡塔尔和阿布扎比在赛历上，我们将在卡塔尔和阿布扎比完成锦标赛。
“我们在这方面跟随一级方程式。一级方程式完全了解所有情况以及需要做什么，以确保我们在最佳条件下进行这两场比赛——情况将会如此。
“由于我们有一个精彩的赛季要收尾，有很多车手参与，三位车手在争夺总冠军，我们非常期待在卡塔尔和阿布扎比进行最后两场比赛。”
有趣的是，科尔顿·赫塔的一句随口评论暗示，今年F2可能不会再有更多比赛了。“不确定这是否是[本赛季]最后一场，或者我们还有更多比赛，但我们会像还有两场比赛要跑一样继续努力，”这位美国人在巴库对Motorsport.com表示。
Motorsport.com将这一评论转达给米歇尔，随后他被问及如果卡塔尔和阿布扎比被取消，是否会有替代比赛，但这位法国人仍然坚定：“嗯，卡塔尔和阿布扎比不会被取消。”
“你知道，车手们总是对很多事情有自己的看法。但我现在告诉你，我们肯定想在那里结束赛季。一级方程式赛车也是这样做的，我们也是如此。”
然而，当被追问冠军是否可能在巴库不知不觉地加冕——若如此，积分榜领先者将是拉斐尔·卡马拉——米歇尔回应道：“你知道，那样会非常令人遗憾，我们不妨这么说。
“我不认为那会发生——说实话，那不会发生。因为我同意你的看法，回过头来说‘哦，顺便说一下，冠军一个月前就已经确定了，但我们没能给你加冕’，那可不怎么好。所以，是的，我们绝对希望以现在的状态完成锦标赛。”
哈斯车队新签下的卡马拉以207分领跑积分榜，红牛青训车手尼古拉·佐洛夫以200分紧随其后，阿尔派培养的车手亚历克斯·邓恩以189分位列第三。
如果再有一轮比赛，这三人将是唯一有机会争夺冠军的车手，而如果卡塔尔和阿布扎比按计划举行，加布里埃莱·米尼、迪诺·贝加诺维奇和诺埃尔·莱昂也将有微小的机会。
detailEn: F2 rebuffs suggestion its title race might be over because of the Iran war
F2 CEO Michel insists the final rounds are happening as planned and there won’t be a retroactively crowned champion
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel has stated the 2026 season-concluding Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds “will not be cancelled”, despite the threat of the Iran war.

The conflict, which was started by United States and Israel strikes in late February, has destabilised the Middle East. Some of the lesser consequences in the grand scheme of things were the impact on racing calendars, with F2’s Bahrain and Saudi rounds replaced by races in Miami and Montreal, as the series races alongside Formula 1.

F1 and race organisers are understood to be both hopeful to run the events as planned and keen not to unilaterally cancel them, for evident financial reasons. Still, the world championship has been preparing a contingency plan, with Imola ready to step in on the first weekend of December, in case those two grands prix can’t happen.

Meanwhile, Formula 2 added a race to its Baku schedule in late September, which is exactly what Formula 3 did at its Madrid season finale to compensate for the loss of its Bahrain round – so the Baku decision was viewed as a way to prepare for potential cancellations.

However, Michel insists the championship’s plans are unchanged: “For the moment – and I think it's completely clear – Qatar and Abu Dhabi are on the calendar, and we are going to finish the championship in Qatar and in Abu Dhabi.

“We're following Formula 1 on that. Formula 1 is completely aware of all the situation and what needs to be done to make sure that we exercise those two races in the best conditions – which will be the case.
“Since we have a fantastic championship to finish with a lot of drivers, three drivers fighting for the title, we're really looking forward to have those last two races in Qatar and in Abu Dhabi.”

Interestingly, a throwaway comment made by Colton Herta suggested there may not be any further racing at all in F2 this year. “Unsure if that's the last one [of the season] or if we have more, but we'll keep working like we have two more races to do,” the American told Motorsport.com in Baku.

This comment was put to Michel by Motorsport.com and he was then asked if there would be replacement races in the event that Qatar and Abu Dhabi were cancelled, but the Frenchman remained adamant: “Well, Qatar and Abu Dhabi will not be cancelled.

“You know, the drivers always have an opinion on a lot of things. But I tell you now, we want to finish the season there for sure. That's what Formula 1 is doing as well and that's what we're doing too.”

However, pressed on whether the champion might have unknowingly been crowned in Baku – in which case it would be standings leader Rafael Camara – Michel responded: “You know, that would be very sad, let's put it that way.

“I don't think it's going to happen – honestly, it's not going to happen. Because I agree with you, going back and saying, ‘Oh, by the way, the champion has been declared a month ago, but we couldn't crown you’, would not be very good. So, yes, we absolutely want to finish the championship as it is now.”
New Haas signing Camara is leading the championship with 207 points to Red Bull junior Nikola Tsolov’s 200 and Alpine protege Alex Dunne’s 189.

The trio would be the only drivers with a shot at the title if there were one more round, while Gabriele Mini, Dino Beganovic and Noel Leon will also have an outside chance if Qatar and Abu Dhabi take place as planned.
